race.description: Scb Distributors The Legend Of The South
race.comment: LET'S GO AGAIN (11) missed by a neck in a F&M BM72 at Warwick Farm after some strong runs in Midway company prior to that. Out slightly in trip to 1300m now, but that doesn't look an issue and she maps to get every chance from the draw. Can get back to winning ways today. HURRY MISS (12) appeals as the main danger off a Canberra win where she overcame a slow start and finished over the top. JVO sticks from that performance and this shapes similarly as she drops in weight. Wouldn't surprise to see her repeat the dose. DUMEBI (8) was sharp winning a BM74 here first-up, beating LADY YARROW by just over two lengths. That's a nice platform for him to build on now. ZARAGOZA (7) drops back from Saturday company after finishing within four lengths at Rosehill. He was a good winner prior at Kembla and despite the wide alley, he can storm over the top late.
